description: Authoritative source feeds for regulatory change detection, one per jurisdiction surface. method poll = we fetch on a cadence; subscribe = the source pushes. mechanism records how a feed is read so the engine can route it.

sources.name: Federal Register (FDA food rules and notices)
sources.notes: JSON API. Primary feed for GRAS, FOP, Healthy, and dye rulemaking. Filter by docket and publication date.

sources.name: FDA food program news and constituent updates
sources.notes: This administration announces policy by press release ahead of formal rules, so the newsroom must be watched alongside the Federal Register.

sources.name: FDA Warning Letters database
sources.notes: FDA enforces food safety and labeling largely through warning letters; the database is a leading signal of enforcement focus for beverages. See regwatch-warning-letters.json for the recurring themes.

sources.name: USDA FNS SNAP waivers and policy
sources.notes: Tracks state SNAP sweetened-beverage restriction waivers and their effective dates.

sources.name: California Legislative Information (leginfo)
sources.notes: Bill text and status for California measures (AB 418, AB 660, AB 2316, AB 1264, AB 2244). California sets the template other states copy.

sources.name: OEHHA Proposition 65 chemical list
sources.notes: The list of ~1,000 chemicals and their safe-harbor levels. Listing changes drive new warning obligations.

sources.name: Multistate food-ingredient legislation tracker (NCSL and FISC)
sources.notes: Aggregate coverage of the 140+ bills across 42 states. Confirmed bills are promoted from the aggregate monitoring row into per-state obligation rows.

sources.name: Health Canada food and supplemented-foods regulations
sources.notes: Supplemented Foods Regulations: caution statements and caffeine limits relevant to functional and energy beverages.

sources.name: Canada Gazette (regulatory notices)
sources.notes: Official publication of proposed and enacted federal regulations, including food additive and labelling amendments.

sources.name: Diario Oficial de la Federacion and COFEPRIS
sources.notes: NOM-051 front-of-pack warning labelling and COFEPRIS additive rules. Strict octagon-warning precedent relevant to sweetened and non-nutritive-sweetened beverages.
